bookingOpens: Online for up to four people through the booking widget on the restaurant's website. Open Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, lunch 12pm to 2pm and dinner 7pm to 9pm; closed Wednesday and at weekends.
groups: Parties of five or six book by email (info@bistrotdunord.be) or by phone during opening hours.
